headline: Firefly Aerospace Inks $1.3 Billion Engine Supply Deal with AST SpaceMobile
summary: Firefly Aerospace has signed a $1.3 billion agreement to supply core engines for a new rocket under development by satellite communications firm AST SpaceMobile.
why: AST SpaceMobile is a satellite communications company scaling its infrastructure, while Firefly Aerospace provides launch services and rocket components.

impacts.name: Firefly Aerospace
impacts.why: Winning a $1.3 billion engine supply contract secures major long-term revenue for Firefly Aerospace.
